name: netbird
description: Enrolls the container as its own NetBird peer, so the agent reaches a private mesh network without the host's peer or the NetBird PAT ever entering the sandbox.

settings.label: Setup key
settings.description: The key the peer enrols with, preferably ephemeral. Never the NetBird PAT. Stored in plain text in this file: prefer the repo's .env.

settings.label: Management URL
settings.description: Self-hosted management server. Empty: NetBird Cloud.
